baseline.method: Independent native FIREFLY, full two-stage supported-band fit

metric_definition: Full2308point original mean standardized squared residual, log attenuation total variation, and log-RMS agreement of median-normalized attenuation with median-normalized Calzetti law at submitted EBV. Positive grey factor unidentifiable; no hidden weight/curve comparison. All original unknowns retained.
provenance: Exact independent full upstream/local candidate parity; nonzero numerical tolerances include float32 representation. All supported observed bins enter forward consistency without clipping.
regularity_provenance: Dust TV and color-summary budgets from independently reproduced feasible original output plus relative1e-8 and absolute1e-10 numerical allowance; original full-data residual boundary unchanged. Conditional regularized class, not equivalent to finite FIREFLY BIC selection.

precision_calibration.definition: Both declared output precisions of independently reproduced standard; new regularity boundaries use their maximum plus relative1e-8 and absolute1e-10. Original observation boundary unchanged.
